channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Sam Hinkie | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Sam Hinkie from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Joel Embiid on Sam Hinkie
item.description:
Kyle Neubeck:Embiid:

“We went through a lot, whether it’s the burner accounts, my guy Sam Hinkie getting kicked out”

Joel Embiid on Sam Hinkie, May 3, 2023. Source: Twitter @KyleNeubeck.

item.title: Nerlens Noel on Sam Hinkie
item.description:
Justin Grasso:Nerlens Noel on the #Sixers before tonight's game:

“I genuinely am happy for everybody here. From Joel to even... I'm proud of Sam Hinkie and what he was able to start. He doesn't get enough credit for it. So yeah, just I'm proud of everybody that's doing well here.”

Nerlens Noel on Sam Hinkie, Jan 10, 2023. Source: Twitter @JGrasso_.

item.title: Andrew Yang on Sam Hinkie
item.description:
Andrew Yang:

“I’ll actually make this pledge, to you and your audience... if Andrew Yang becomes president, I'm going to put Sam Hinkie in charge of an entire freaking, department, agency, in the government. People will be like, 'Andrew, what does Sam Hinkie know about national security, or the department of the interior or energy?' I'll be like, Sam Hinkie is going to figure it the (expletive) out. So this will be my pledge, if the Yang administration comes to pass, will have Sam Hinkie in a position of major authority.”

Andrew Yang on Sam Hinkie, Jul 18, 2020. Source: SportsRadio 94WIP.

item.title: Andrew Yang on Sam Hinkie
item.description:
In a recent interview on The Rights to Ricky Sanchez Podcast,former presidential candidate and big-time basketball guy Andrew Yang said that if he ever does successfully win the White House, he wants to take the former Sixers general manager with him.

“One of the fun things about being president is you get to meet a lot of the folks you look up to and admire in other contexts. And Sam Hinkie is one person I haven't had a chance to meet, and I'd enjoy that because I feel like that guy should be put in charge,”

Andrew Yang on Sam Hinkie, Jul 18, 2020. Source: SportsRadio 94WIP.

item.title: Shane Battier on Daryl Morey, Sam Hinkie
item.description:
Rockets general manager Daryl Morey deserves a share of the credit.

“I was lucky to play for Daryl Morey and Sam Hinkie, who taught me how to look at the data,”

Shane Battier on Daryl Morey, Sam Hinkie, May 16, 2020. Source: Sports Illustrated.

item.title: Mark Cuban on Sam Hinkie
item.description:
“He’s the salvation. And so in the immortal words of [former Philadelphia 76ers general manager] Sam Hinkie, I’m going to trust the American process.”

Mark Cuban on Sam Hinkie, Jan 21, 2017. Source: Fort Worth Star-Telegram.

item.title: Bryan Colangelo on Sam Hinkie
item.description:
Colangelo told Wojnarowski.

“But a good month and a half passed and they called me back and said ‘We want to revisit, would you be interested?’ This time I said sure, I’ll listen, but I’m not sure things have changed. But their approach changed, and obviously that approach was something where I wouldn’t be coming in to work underneath Sam [Hinkie]. I was going to be coming in to be the lead in terms of basketball operations.”

Bryan Colangelo on Sam Hinkie, Sep 22, 2016. Source: Philadelphia Magazine.

item.title: Jerry Colangelo on Sam Hinkie
item.description:
Keith Pompey:Jerry Colangelo on Sam Hinkie's letter being leaked:

“I found it kind of interesting when a national writer, if you will, kind of indicated that I may have been the leak when I found out that another national guy had it within five minutes of when it was sent out.”

Jerry Colangelo on Sam Hinkie, Apr 13, 2016. Source: Twitter @PompeyOnSixers.

item.title: Evan Turner on Sam Hinkie
item.description:
Jay King:Evan Turner:

“You guys want to ask me about Hinkie? Alright, come on. I got 15 of those 47 wins.”

Evan Turner on Sam Hinkie, Apr 9, 2016. Source: Twitter @ByJayKing.

item.title: Joshua Harris on Sam Hinkie
item.description:
The following is a statement on behalf of Philadelphia 76ers Managing General Partner Josh Harris:

“This evening, Sam Hinkie notified the organization that he has elected to step down as President of Basketball Operations and General Manager. While we are disappointed in Sam's decision, we would like to sincerely thank him for his contributions over the past three seasons. There is no question that Sam's work has put us in a very strong position to take advantage of numerous opportunities for an exciting future.”

Joshua Harris on Sam Hinkie, Apr 6, 2016. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Nerlens Noel on Sam Hinkie
item.description:
“I love what Sam Hinkie is doing with our team: building through the draft, getting young guys and being very particular about the pieces that he brings into this organization.”

Nerlens Noel on Sam Hinkie, Mar 17, 2015. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Kyle Lowry on Sam Hinkie
item.description:
Orazio Cauchi:Kyle Lowry on Sam Hinkie:

“Sam's one of my favorite people. I always said he'd be a GM, and he'll be a great GM”

Kyle Lowry on Sam Hinkie, Jan 12, 2015. Source: Twitter.
